AboutMe.A1: Hello there! Thank you for visiting my website. I thought building it would be a good opportunity to take stock of my programming knowledge and try out a few new web design ideas. Also, having worked as a programmer for over 6 years at the time of writing (2020), I figured it wouldn't hurt to have one. :)
AboutMe.A2: I have an analytical mind, but I also think of myself as creative and always on the lookout for new solutions. As a programmer I care about building things that satisfy the user and invite interaction. For some time I worked in the video game industry, but these days I focus on .NET, frontend technologies and exploring everything that AI-powered tooling has to offer.
AboutMe.A2AI: That last one has become a natural part of my daily routine, both at work and in my private projects. I treat AI as another tool rather than a shortcut - it takes over the repetitive parts and speeds up getting to know unfamiliar libraries, leaving me more time for the architecture, the user experience and the quality of the final solution, for which I remain responsible.

Godel.Desc: I work for a British company that is a leader of re-commerce in the UK and US and develops its own platform for selling and renting consumer technology. My team is responsible for the checkout process.
Godel.Resp1: New software development: coding, debugging, testing
Godel.Resp2: Participating in deployments, planning, creating tasks, discussing epics
Godel.Resp3: Analysis, maintenance, investigating and reporting bugs

Sii.Desc: Assigned to mBank Lodz Headquarters (one of Sii partners) as external worker. I work in a small team participating in wide range of projects: to be used mainly, but not only, in internal bank structures. Requirements are very diverse: from small tools designed to support work within the team, to complex multi-layered web services and systems. Our team focuses on the use of modern technologies and develops high-quality, testable software.
Sii.Resp1: New software development: coding, debugging, testing
Sii.Resp2: Deployment: creating packages, configuring CI/CD pipeline
Sii.Resp4: Maintaining and updating existing products, eliminating technological debt
Sii.Resp5: Resolving user requests and fixing bugs

Infosys.Desc: I was entirely responsible for developing, maintaining and supporting a tool designed for reporting work of one of the Infosys's BPO teams – Swedish telecommunications company. The tool was a WPF application communicating with SQL Server, it had multiple functionalities:
Infosys.Desc1: creating, processing, tracking and reporting tickets;
Infosys.Desc3: reporting users' work time and efficiency.
Infosys.Resp1: Tool development based on user change requests and my own suggestions
Infosys.Resp4: Attending end-users meetings and advising on pending changes, supporting in everyday work

Teyon.Desc2: Work at a company being a producer and publisher of computer games with global reach. Authorised developer for all major platforms.
